title: Freeze, Don't Clone: Fine-Tuning with Expressive Policies Without Retaining Offline Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.36247v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning uses offline pretraining to accelerate subsequent online learning. While many methods assume the offline dataset remains available throughout fine-tuning, there are many settings where this is not the case. Prior work attributes failures in this setting primarily to critic recalibration under distribution shift. We identify a complementary actor-side failure: once the offline data disappears, continued behavioral cloning (BC) no longer preserves the offline behavior distribution and instead refits the behavioral model to the agent's limited, and nonstationary, online experience. We demonstrate that stopping online behavioral fitting while preserving the pretrained expressive prior substantially improves no-retention fine-tuning across implicit flow Q-learning (IFQL), flow Q-learning (FQL), and action-chunked RL (QC) on seven OGBench domains. translated_title: 冻结而非克隆：无需保留离线数据的表达性策略微调
translated_abstract: 离线到在线强化学习利用离线预训练来加速后续的在线学习。虽然许多方法假设离线数据集在整个微调过程中始终可用，但在许多实际场景中并非如此。以往的工作将这种场景下的失败主要归因于分布偏移下评论家（critic）的重新校准。我们识别出一种互补的执行者（actor）侧的失败模式：一旦离线数据消失，持续的行为克隆（BC）不再保留离线行为分布，而是将行为模型重新拟合到智能体有限的、非平稳的在线经验上。我们证明，在保留预训练表达性先验的同时停止在线行为拟合，可以在七个 OGBench 域上显著改进隐式流 Q 学习（IFQL）、流 Q 学习（FQL）和动作分块强化学习（QC）的无保留微调性能。我们将这种失败追溯到行为反馈循环：（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文发现离线数据消失后持续进行行为克隆会通过行为反馈循环导致性能退化，提出冻结预训练表达性策略先验并停止在线行为拟合的方法，在七个OGBench域上显著提升了IFQL、FQL和QC等算法在无需保留离线数据场景下的微调效果。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies that continued behavioral cloning after offline data disappears degrades performance through a behavioral feedback loop, and demonstrates that freezing the pretrained expressive policy prior while stopping online behavioral fitting substantially improves no-retention fine-tuning across IFQL, FQL, and QC on seven OGBench domains.
